levels.terse: A short pitch: the subject and little else.
levels.rich: The same subject with many creative details: colours, character, accessories, mood, in plain words.

subjects.rich: A red panda balancing on a mossy branch. Rusty red fur on its back, a black belly and legs, a round white face with red tear marks running from the eyes, white-rimmed pointed ears, a little black nose, and a big fluffy tail with bold cream and ginger rings. It holds a bamboo shoot in one paw and looks delighted.

A panther chameleon walking along a twig. Its body shifts from turquoise at the head through lime green to sunset orange at the tail, with a white stripe along its side and red bars across it. A ridged crest on its head, turret eyes looking in two directions, mitten-like feet gripping the twig, and a tightly coiled tail.

A startled pufferfish fully puffed up into a ball. Creamy yellow skin with brown leopard spots on top fading to a white belly, short spikes all over, a tiny pouting mouth, big worried round eyes, small fluttering side fins and a stubby fan-shaped tail. A few bubbles rise from its mouth.

A newborn unicorn foal on wobbly long legs. A pearly white coat with a soft lilac shimmer, a short fluffy mane and tail in pastel pink, mint and lavender, a small spiralled horn in gold, big dark eyes with long lashes, little silver hooves, and a daisy chain hanging around its neck.

A 1950s diner jukebox. A tall rounded arch of glowing coloured tubes in red, amber and teal, chrome trim everywhere, a domed glass window showing a stack of records and the arm that picks them, rows of chrome selection buttons with little title cards, a speaker grille with a starburst pattern, and a coin slot.
